## Walkthrough

This PR updates the `@typeberry/native` dependency across multiple package.json files to version `^0.0.4-92ff682`, introduces a new `verifyHeaderSeals` async function in the bandersnatch VRF and WASM modules, and refactors the safrole seal verification logic by splitting verification into specialized ticket-based and key-based private handlers. The changes include removing the `IncorrectEntropySource` error enum member, adjusting the `SafroleSealState` type signature, and updating the entropy hash handling throughout the verification flow.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes

## Possibly related PRs

- FluffyLabs/typeberry#638: Both PRs modify Bandersnatch VRF/WASM interfaces and safrole seal verification paths with changes to verification-related functions and signatures
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#649: Both PRs update `@typeberry/native` dependency declarations and versions in packages/core directories
- FluffyLabs/typeberry#450: Related through new safrole seal verification API additions that directly impact the verification bypass mechanisms
